title: Grateful Dead Live at Bayfront Center Arena on 1988-10-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Michael Hessberg's Master Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: A solid sounding recording that stands out with a rocking Truckin' featuring an unexpected CSNY "Carry On" vamp and a first‑time “Blow Away” cameo.
ai_review.review: The reviewer finds the sound quality superior to other available copies, noting a clear and enjoyable listening experience. Musically the highlight is Truckin', where a brief CSNY "Carry On" vamp adds excitement, and the surprise appearance of "Blow Away" is praised as a rock‑inspired moment.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it rates the show 4 stars, praises both performance and sound quality, with no major complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer says this copy sounds better than other versions and provides no criticism of clarity or mix, implying a generally good recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed set‑list commentary; the review focuses on the unique "Carry On" vamp within Truckin' and the excitement of hearing Blow Away for the first time.
